title: makerspet/oomwoo
claim: makerspet/oomwoo — An open-source robot vacuum: LiDAR SLAM on ESP32, ROS2, Home Assistant, fully hackable.
hook: An open-source robot vacuum you can build and flash yourself — LiDAR SLAM, ROS2 and Home Assistant, no cloud.
why_good: An open-source robot vacuum you build yourself — Raspberry Pi, 3D-printed chassis, Arduino/ESP32, a cheap 2D LiDAR for mapping and autonomous ROS2/Nav2 navigation, native Home Assistant, fully local with no cloud.
value: Buyer: home-lab makers and robotics-education programs. Money: parts kits or assembled units and a supported pro firmware/app layer.
risk: Very early: official build instructions land Fall 2026 and v0 is bare-bones with most deliverables unfinished. Hardware is capital- and support-heavy, and iRobot/Roborock own manufacturing and price — right now it's 'can they ship,' not a usable product.

zh.claim: makerspet/oomwoo —— 开源扫地机器人:ESP32 上跑 LiDAR SLAM,支持 ROS2、Home Assistant,完全可魔改。
zh.hook: 一台你能自己组装、自己刷固件的开源扫地机器人——LiDAR SLAM、ROS2、接 Home Assistant,全程不上云。
zh.why_good: 一台你自己动手造的开源扫地机器人:Raspberry Pi + 3D 打印外壳 + Arduino/ESP32,用便宜的 2D LiDAR 建图、跑 ROS2/Nav2 自主导航,原生接 Home Assistant,全本地、不依赖云。
zh.value: 买家:家庭实验室创客和机器人教育项目。变现:零件套件或整机,以及带支持的专业固件/应用层。
zh.risk: 现状很早:官方 build 说明要 2026 秋才出,v0 还是骨架、多数交付项没完成。硬件既烧钱又烧售后,iRobot/石头握着制造与价格——现在是『看它能不能真交付』,不是能上手的产品。
zh.does: 一台你自己动手造的开源扫地机器人:Raspberry Pi + 3D 打印外壳 + Arduino/ESP32,用便宜的 2D LiDAR 建图、跑 ROS2/Nav2 自主导航,原生接 Home Assistant,全本地、不依赖云。
zh.edge: 它把整台机器人都开源了——家电级的硬件、固件和 ROS2 软件,全部可 3D 打印、可魔改、无厂商锁定——市面上几乎没有第二家。
zh.why_use: 适合注重隐私、爱折腾的智能家居玩家和机器人教育——想要一台不上云、能自己改和自己修的扫地机。

does: An open-source robot vacuum you build yourself — Raspberry Pi, 3D-printed chassis, Arduino/ESP32, a cheap 2D LiDAR for mapping and autonomous ROS2/Nav2 navigation, native Home Assistant, fully local with no cloud.
edge: It opens up the whole robot — appliance-grade hardware, firmware and ROS2 software, all 3D-printable and hackable with no vendor lock-in — which basically nothing on the market offers.
why_use: For privacy-minded smart-home tinkerers and robotics education who want a no-cloud vacuum they can actually modify and repair.
